review.editorial: Separate full Chinese pass checked scene geography, physical action, viewpoint, voices and pacing; revised one inconsistent action verb and reread fixed scene. Complete companion English reread and dialogue punctuation refined before final reader review.

Contextual readings checked with counterexamples. Actual saved sentence and Listen source units inspected without speech generation.
